edges.reason: Caller-controlled msg.sender is returned by _msgSender, which is the only source of caller identity used across the token.
transfer() passes _msgSender() as the sender argument of _transfer, so the untrusted caller directly determines which balance is debited.
_approve is called with _msgSender() as owner in approve/increaseAllowance/decreaseAllowance, making the allowance owner caller-controlled.
transferFrom reads _allowances[sender][_msgSender()], so the untrusted caller determines which allowance is consumed.
The SimpleERC20 constructor mints the whole initial supply to _msgSender(), giving the deployer/caller all tokens.
_balances is read by balanceOf.
_allowances is read by allowance.
_totalSupply is read by totalSupply.
_name is read by name().
_symbol is read by symbol().
_version is read by version().
_GENERATOR constant is returned by generator().
ERC20 constructor writes the name_ argument into _name.
ERC20 constructor writes the symbol_ argument into _symbol.
GeneratorCopyright constructor writes version_ into _version.
transfer forwards recipient, amount and the caller identity into _transfer.
transferFrom calls _transfer before allowance bookkeeping.
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the remaining allowance.
approve delegates the allowance write to _approve.
increaseAllowance delegates the allowance write to _approve.
decreaseAllowance delegates the allowance write to _approve.
SimpleERC20 calls the ERC20 base constructor with name_ and symbol_.
SimpleERC20 calls the payable ServicePayer base constructor with feeReceiver_.
SimpleERC20 invokes the GeneratorCopyright base constructor with the literal version v5.0.1.
SimpleERC20 constructor calls _mint to create the entire initial supply.
ServicePayer constructor makes an external payable call to an arbitrary receiver while forwarding msg.value, which can execute attacker code during construction.
_transfer invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before state updates, so a derived override could re-enter.
_mint invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before supply and balance updates.
_burn invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before balance and supply updates.
transferFrom computes currentAllowance - amount, an arithmetic operation dependent on user-supplied amount.
_transfer performs senderBalance - amount and _balances[recipient] += amount arithmetic.
_mint performs _totalSupply += amount and _balances[account] += amount arithmetic.
_burn performs balance and total-supply subtraction arithmetic.
